description:
Move a document through its lifecycle.

- `finalized` — Issue a `draft`: fix its number and totals.
- `sent` — Record that the document reached the customer.
- `paid` — Record that the document was paid in full.
- `unpaid` — Undo `mark_paid`, returning the document to `sent`.
- `void` — Cancel a document that was issued.
- `archived` — Move a document out of the active list.
- `restored` — Bring an archived document back to `finalized`.

Each transition is only valid from certain states and is refused with 409 otherwise. To actually email a document to its customer, use `document_send` — `to: "sent"` only records that it happened.
